name: dna-encoder
description: DNA Storage Codec Application - Research prototype for encoding/decoding digital data to/from DNA quaternary sequences

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:services: cd services/user-management && npm install && cd ../codec-service && npm install && cd ../object-storage && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install
scripts.install:frontend: cd frontend/web && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:services && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:services: cd services/user-management && npm run build && cd ../codec-service && npm run build && cd ../object-storage && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend/web && npm run build && cd ../mobile && npm run build

author: DNA Encoder Team
